title: Panwise recipe contract
description: Draft of the Go-to-Dart contract (ADR 0002, ADR 0004). Draft and Recipe share one body; a Recipe adds ownership and revision. Readers ignore unknown fields and map unknown enum values to the fallback named on each enum (H19). Timestamps are RFC 3339 strings on the wire; their Firestore representation is decided in #22.

Unit.description: Closed set, metric canonical. g and ml are converted at display (g to oz/lb, ml to fl oz/cups, and up to kg/l); tsp, tbsp and the count units are shown as written in both systems. The model never emits imperial units, kg or l. Unknown value fallback: show the quantity with no unit and do not convert.

MealType.description: Unknown value fallback: drop the value.

id.description: Unique within the recipe, referenced by Step.ingredientIds. Stable across revisions of the same Recipe.

name.description: The ingredient alone: 'onion', not '1 large onion, finely diced'.

quantity.description: Null together with unit when there is no amount ('to taste', 'for greasing'); the reason goes in preparation.

preparation.description: How the ingredient is prepared or used: 'finely diced', 'to taste', 'for serving'.

group.description: Optional heading the ingredient is listed under, such as 'For the sauce'. An ingredient used in two separate portions is two lines, usually in different groups, so a step can reference the right amount.

text.description: Names ingredients without their quantities and leaves out oven and oil temperatures; the client renders both beside the step from ingredientIds and temperatureC in the viewer's unit system. Lengths, which have no structured home, are written in both systems: '2 cm (3/4 in)'.

ingredientIds.description: Ingredients first used in this step. Every id must exist in ingredients; the Go post-process stage rejects a Draft that breaks this.

timerSeconds.description: Set only where the step contains a real wait ('simmer for 15 minutes'). The Cooking Session offers it as a timer. Not reconciled with the recipe's time totals.

temperatureC.description: Celsius, converted to Fahrenheit at display.

Cookware.description: One piece of cookware. The cookware Generation Limit counts the entries of the cookware list.

source.description: Drives the 'estimate' label. Unknown value fallback: treat as an estimate.

Cover.description: Tagged value. The emoji is always kept, so removing a photo needs no model call. Unknown kind fallback: show the emoji.

photoPath.description: Cloud Storage path under the owner's per-Recipe prefix, never a tokenised download URL (H13). Present when kind is 'photo'. A Draft never has one.

Source.description: Provenance, present on Drafts and Recipes (H4). v1 only writes kind 'generated'. Unknown kind fallback: render the recipe and show no attribution.

derivedFrom.description: The Recipe this one was copied from, for later sharing and versioning. Never set in v1. A Refinement does not set it: the chain of Drafts belongs to the generation flow, not to the recipe.

Draft.description: What the Go service returns. Holds nothing about the Generation Request that produced it (H16).

id.description: UUIDv7 minted by the Go service. Globally unique, not only per owner. Saving keeps it as the Recipe id; a Refinement yields a Draft with a new id.

activeMinutes.description: Hands-on time. activeMinutes + passiveMinutes is the time to make, which the time Generation Limit is checked against.

ingredients.description: The ingredient Generation Limit counts the entries of this list.

cuisine.description: One free-text cuisine such as 'Thai'. Null when unknown, which a generated Draft never is.

Recipe.description: A saved Draft. Written by the client straight to Firestore (ADR 0001). Renders from this document alone (H5): Rating and Collection membership are owner-private and their placement is decided in #22.

revision.description: Starts at 1. Goes up when the recipe content changes (anything a cook would notice: title, servings, ingredients, steps, times, cookware). Replacing the Cover only touches updatedAt. v1 has no way to change content, so it is always 1.

Rating.description: Owner-private (H5, H9). Defined here so Go and Dart share the shape; where it is stored is decided in #22.
